before_snippet:
import redis
client = redis.Redis(host='localhost', port=6379, decode_responses=True)
try:
    # In 7.4.1, RESP2 is default, so responses are in RESP2 format
    # Some commands return different structures in RESP3 by default
    client.ping()
    # This should work in both versions but the underlying protocol differs
    assert True
except Exception as e:
    raise e
